caption: R54 000 and R1 000 left. Does a bigger salary just come with bigger bills?

slides.title:
How I spend my
R54 000 p/m
salary
Living in Fourways
slides.body:
Female, 34
Single, no kids
Job: Senior actuarial analyst
Net salary: R54 000 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.body: I stay in Fourways for the commute. It is also why the rent is what it is.

slides.title: Car
slides.body: I upgraded last year. The old one was fine. I know.

slides.title: Eating out and delivery
slides.includes: Dinners, Uber Eats, the weekend brunch
slides.body: I earn well and I do not cook. I checked this number twice because I did not believe it.

slides.title: Black tax
slides.includes: My parents' home in Mthatha, my brother's university fees
slides.body: My salary is not only mine. It never was, and I never expected it to be.

slides.title: Medical aid
slides.body: I am on the better plan because of my mom's history. I stopped arguing with myself about it.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: groceries, petrol, prepaid electricity, fibre & phone, funeral policy, stokvel, gym, online shopping & subscriptions, retirement top-up
slides.body: Nine line items, R16 700. The stokvel is my monthly reminder that other people are counting on me.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R54 000. On a salary this size, R1 000 left over felt like the wrong answer.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statement to Beyond Horizon expecting a high salary to explain itself.

The eating out number was higher than my car.

No bank login needed.
